source.name: Al-Hilal Club: Al-Hilal and Riyad Bank… An Extended Partnership
source.quote: finalized the renewal of its partnership with Riyad Bank for five seasons

note: Renewal of the partnership that began in 2023; no value reported. A newsletter (mskhanlab.substack.com, supplementary edition) reported SAR 157.5m (~USD 42m) for the original 2023 agreement - single unverified source.
